animations.name: Sweep Knockdown Recovery
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied supine knockdown pose lying flat on the ground and end in the exact supplied standing fighting guard pose. Animate a smooth, continuous, athletic get-up recovery spread evenly across the clip, pure body motion only in completely empty air around the fighter: first the fighter pushes their upper body off the ground with one hand and forearm while tucking their legs underneath; next they plant both feet on the ground baseline passing smoothly through a compact low crouch; finally they rise upright with controlled momentum and bring both fists back into the exact supplied standing fighting guard pose. Keep the entire body cleanly centered inside the 512x512 frame along the ground baseline. Preserve exact face, hairstyle, reference outfit, footwear, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
